experiments_completed.description: Identical continuous 61D input tabular MLP vs Mini-LLM baseline
experiments_completed.findings: CatBoost (52.25%) and Logistic Regression (53.94%) outperform single-snapshot Mini-LLM (53.45%)

experiments_completed.description: Temporal horizon ablation (T=1, T=4, T=24 / stride-4 window)
experiments_completed.findings: T=4 (49.19% precision, PF 1.99) and T=24/stride-4 (46.40% precision, PF 1.80) prevent signal collapse, but overall accuracy (53.63%) shows no incremental gain over simpler tabular baselines

official_verdict: Temporal context changes Mini-LLM behavior and restores signal generation, but the experiment does not demonstrate a clear predictive advantage over simpler tabular approaches. The Mini-LLM branch is therefore parked rather than advanced to richer tokenization or QLoRA.
